label: Custom parameters
help: Encoder parameters as key=value, separated by colons. They are added after every other encoder option. A one-frame test encode checks them when you stop typing.

check.failed: The one-frame test did not run: {reason}

hdr.noMetadata: Nothing to copy: the source has no HDR10 metadata (mastering display or content light level).
hdr.fromFrames: Nothing to copy: {encoder} takes the HDR metadata from the frames, so it has no options for it.
hdr.cannotCarry: Nothing to copy: {encoder} cannot write HDR10 metadata.
hdr.failed: The HDR metadata could not be copied: {reason}
